World

Hearthford first playable village

A compact service and quest loop inside Rillmere, not a separate unnecessary world server.

On this page
Playable village chain

Spawn shrine west; central square services; bridge east to wilderness; bank and crafting court north; dry fishing pier south; north road to Thornweald. Keep required services within a proposed 90-second walking loop.

Playable village chain

  1. Create/select A, enter shrine, talk to Mara for First Steps and learn interaction without receiving repeated starter grants.
  2. Accept Road Supplies, move onto WestRoad, defeat Mossfang, claim personal loot and record kill/loot objective events.
  3. Mine ore, cut ash, fish from dry pier and craft IronHatchet at forge; use server-approved events to progress objectives.
  4. Buy/sell/buyback a draught, equip sword/shield/cloak under visual compatibility rules, then finish the quest for one XP/currency receipt.
  5. Die/recover and transfer north/reconnect. Verify all IDs/quantities/objectives/appearance remain consistent.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
